source.title: Methodology of estimating 2018 election results on new electoral boundaries

coverage.reconciliation: each row sums to 100 within 0.05 percentage points

limitations: This is a two-candidate-preferred local baseline, not a complete multi-party primary vector.
It may support the ballot/boundary gate but does not by itself open the v2 incumbency/local-input gate.
The target 2022 result and the 2018-to-2022 outcome-transition artefact are not used.
